requirement_vague: Verify that a second user cannot read another user's item. Confirm access is denied.

omissions.description: The GET /items/{item_id} endpoint does not check whether the requesting user owns the item. Any authenticated user can read any item regardless of ownership. The endpoint should return HTTP 400 with detail 'Not enough permissions' when a non-owner (non-superuser) attempts to read an item they do not own.
omissions.reasoning: The read_item function retrieves the item and returns it immediately after a 404 check, with no ownership validation. The ownership guard (checking item.owner_id != current_user.id) present in update_item and delete_item is absent here, so a second user can successfully read another user's item instead of being denied with a 400 error.
